name: NestJS + Next.js Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform
description: Modular multi-tenant SaaS platform using NestJS for backend and Next.js 14 (App Router) with Tailwind CSS for the frontend. Features include attribution analytics, CRM, marketing reporting, compliance, and cloud-ready infrastructure.

rules.rule: Project must follow a monorepo layout with apps/ for applications and libs/ for shared logic
Only apps/ can contain main.ts (NestJS) or app/ (Next.js) as application entrypoints
Every NestJS module must contain a Module class and only inject Services into Controllers
Controllers must only handle request routing and delegation; no business logic allowed in controllers
DTOs must be used for all incoming requests and responses, defined in libs/
Tenant must be resolved using either subdomain or JWT claim (tenant_id) in a global NestJS interceptor
All backend services and queries must use the injected tenant context
JWT authentication must use Passport strategy with access and refresh tokens
Use @UseGuards(AuthGuard) and @CurrentUser() to secure all protected backend endpoints
Every service must be unit tested using Jest in its respective lib/ or app/
E2E tests must validate tenant scoping, auth flow, and API behavior
All DTOs, interceptors, and guards must include error and edge case test coverage
Do not use any; use interfaces or typed DTOs from libs/shared
All backend services must return Result<T> or equivalent typed responses
Frontend must use Next.js 14+ with the App Router (app/ directory structure)
Use Tailwind CSS for all styling; do not use SCSS or CSS modules
All components must be reusable and located in apps/web/components following Atomic Design (atoms, molecules, organisms)
Forms must use shared components and validation via React Hook Form or Zod
Icons must be from Untitled UI and imported as React components under apps/web/icons/
All charts and tables must use wrapper components (e.g., <ChartWrapper>) for flexibility and reusability
Pages must use layout.tsx and page.tsx files under app/ and follow clean routing
Reports must be built from reusable dashboard components with prop-driven behavior
Analytics logic must reside in libs/analytics as pure or service functions
Do not perform data aggregation in frontend; fetch prepared data via API
All PII must be hashed unless tier 3/4 consent is explicitly given
Consent must be validated against server-side rule maps per event
Logs must include tenant ID, event type, and consent tier
Environment-specific variables must be managed with .env files and .env.example templates
Infrastructure must be defined under infrastructure/ using Terraform or Serverless Framework
CI/CD must be defined via GitHub Actions in infrastructure/ci-cd/ with matrix testing for apps and libs
